messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 429/503 spike detected for inference-proxy (us-west-2). 429 rate = 5.8% over 6m, 503s increasing. Trigger: error_thresholds/high_429_503.

maria: oncall here. I'm seeing the spike on the live-429 dashboard. tagging @aj to take lead on mitigation. passing to SRE runbook step 1.

aj: on it. grabbing logs and checking routing. initial gut: a handful of noisy tenants + a sudden embeddings batch job. will try surgical rate limits first.

kai: I can push a short-lived traffic-shape rule from the controller. plan: 1) per-tenant rps cap for free/burst tier 2) disable embeddings for non-paying tenants 3) enable degraded-model fallback for generation endpoints. Any objections?

maria: sounds good. prioritize low-risk actions first. document all changes here.

aj: running query to find top offenders:```
-- top tenants by 429s last 10m
SELECT tenant_id, sum(429_count) as errors, sum(requests) as reqs FROM metrics WHERE region='us-west-2' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 10;
```

aj: top three are tenant_42 (spike from heavy batch), tenant_free_7 (chatty test harness), tenant_99 (unknown bot).

kai: applying controller rule now (canary to 10% host). command:
```
trafficctl set-shape --region us-west-2 --policy live-mitigation-1847654321 --cap-rps 30 --targets "tenant_free_*" --canary 10
```

kai: canary applied. watching. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/429-503/live?org=us-west-2 (posted by sre-bot)

sre-bot: metric feed: 429 rate dropped to 3.6% in canary hosts after 90s. 503s unchanged on backbone.

aj: rolling cap to 100% for free/burst tier (30rps). enabling degraded-model fallback for generation (model-small) for tenants with >2% error.

maria: please also reduce default burst quota for anonymous API keys to 5rps. that's low-risk and likely to reduce head-of-line queues.

kai: done. command:
```
adminctl set-quota --scope anonymous --region us-west-2 --rps 5 --burst 10 --note "live mitigation 1847654321"
```

julia: heads-up from support: three enterprise customers reported 503s (tickets #2248 #2249 #2250). they're seeing timeouts on long-poll endpoints. impact windows: start ~5m ago. forwarding ticket links.

aj: investigating 503 stack traces — looks like backend model workers are OOMing on long embedding batches. will temporarily block large embedding payloads (>2k tokens) for non-enterprise tenants.

kai: policy applied to traffic-controller: block payloads > 2k for free & burst. logging returns 413 for those requests now.

sre-bot: quick metric update: overall 429 rate now 2.1%, 503 rate down from 1.4% to 0.9% in 7m. request latency slightly up due to fallback (p95 +120ms).

maria: good trend. compile short customer impact note for handoff: 1) outages limited to a subset of tenants (listed) 2) three enterprise tickets opened but they are on enterprise plan — we've prioritized them and applied fallbacks per-customer 3) mitigations: per-tenant caps, reduced anonymous quotas, blocked large embedding payloads, degraded-model fallback.

aj: adding KB entries to the incident channel + runbook with exact commands and rollback steps. Rollback plan: revert quotas and policies when 429 < 0.5% and 503 < 0.2% sustained for 15m.

maria: scheduling handoff — I'll stay for 30m to monitor, then hand to @kai at 04:00Z. Kai, please watch for regression if background batch jobs resume and consider a transient worker autoscale bump if 503s rise again.

kai: acknowledged. I'll take over at 04:00Z. also enabling additional tracing for tenant_42 to capture batch job signature.

ops-bot: deployed change set: live-mitigation-1847654321 by kai. CI: ok.

julia: I'll update the support tickets with the mitigation summary and ETA for permanent mitigation (engineering follow-up).

maria: summary for handoff (copyable): "Mitigation applied: per-tenant rps caps for free/burst, anonymous quota reduced to 5rps, large embedding payloads blocked >2k tokens for non-enterprise, degraded-model fallback enabled. Current metrics: 429=2.1%, 503=0.9%, p95 latency +120ms. Next steps: monitor for 15m stable window, then gradually revert. On-call: kai (takeover at 04:00Z)."

aj: leaving monitoring alerts at higher sensitivity for next 30m.

kai: 10-4. will escalate to infra if OOMs persist.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll post a brief incident note to #incidents once we hit the stable threshold. :white_check_mark:
